T0.scene_summary: A narrow galley kitchen with a stove on the left, cabinets and countertop on the right, and a doorway and potted plant at the far end.
T0.overall_evidence: The main kitchen arrangement, appliance colors, plant and doorway are recognizable. However, the viewpoint crops the stove differently, the reconstruction is much palainer and more washed out, and several prominent surface and lighting details are missing.

main_defects.description: The view is more frontal and centered on the back wall, with the stove cut off at the left and bottom rather than showing most of its large front face. The right countertop also occupies a different foreground shape.
main_defects.evidence: The reference shows the stove's broad dark front nearly to its base, while the reconstruction shows mostly the cooktop and only a cropped part of the front.
main_defects.uncertainty: Differences in object dimensions may contribute as well as camera placement.

main_defects.description: The reconstruction replaces much of the reference's visible surface variation with nearly uniform pastel surfaces: the wood-grain floor, veined counter, metallic stove controls and darker appliance face are substantially simplified.
main_defects.evidence: Wood grain and strong counter veining are visible in the reference, whereas the reconstruction floor is pale, mostly flat planking and the counter has only faint lines.
main_defects.uncertainty: Lighting and exposure can also suppress visible surface contrast.

main_defects.description: The reference has pronounced contrast, a dark doorway and a bright diagonal patch of sunlight on the floor; the reconstruction has much flatter, brighter illumination without the comparable light patch.
main_defects.evidence: The reference floor contains a distinct bright diagonal region and the doorway is nearly black at its lower portion; neither appears similarly in the reconstruction.
main_defects.uncertainty: The dark doorway could partly reflect a different visible door or background surface, not just illumination.

main_defects.description: The stove control panel lacks the visible central clock and small markings, and the cooktop has five visible burner circles rather than the reference's six.
main_defects.evidence: The reference panel reads 12:01 between two knobs and shows six circular burner zones; the reconstruction panel is blank between the knobs and five zones are visible.
main_defects.uncertainty: The image crop could conceal part of the reconstructed cooktop.

main_defects.description: The plant is noticeably smaller and more delicate in the reconstruction, with a smaller pot and a shorter-looking leafy stem relative to the back wall.
main_defects.evidence: The reference plant has a prominent tall flower bud and broad pot; the reconstruction has a slender stylized stem with small leaves and a narrower-looking pot.
main_defects.uncertainty: Perspective and framing influence apparent size; the reference's terminal bud may be represented by the pointed top of the reconstructed plant.

strengths: The narrow galley layout and left stove/right cabinet arrangement are recognizable.
The stove has a pale cooktop, circular burners, two purple knobs and a purple handle.
A pale counter, multicolored drawer fronts, upper cabinets, rear doorway and potted plant are present in broadly corresponding positions.
T0.uncertainty: This is an initial automated judgment from two rendered views, not a human rating or validated aggregate metric. Differences in framing, exposure and occlusion make it difficult to separate camera, geometry and material effects; no hidden geometry is evaluated.

T1.scene_summary: A narrow kitchen with a range on the left, a long counter and cabinets on the right, and a doorway and potted plant at the far end.
T1.overall_evidence: The main kitchen arrangement and several distinctive objects are recognizable, but the view differs substantially in framing and perspective, the range and cabinetry are simplified, and the reference's strong material contrasts, floor texture, and directional light are largely absent. This is a coarse automated judgment, not a human rating or validated metric.

main_defects.description: The reconstruction frames the range much closer and cuts off most of its body, while the reference shows its full front and more of the floor. The right counter and doorway also occupy different positions in the frame, changing the sense of the aisle.
main_defects.evidence: The reference range's lower front reaches almost to the floor and is entirely visible horizontally; the reconstruction range extends beyond the left and bottom image edges. The doorway is farther right in the reference.
main_defects.uncertainty: Differences may reflect both camera placement and underlying scene proportions; a single view cannot separate them reliably.

main_defects.description: The reconstruction is much paler and flatter, losing the reference's visible wood-grain floor, dark range front, stronger cabinet color contrasts, and textured counter surfaces.
main_defects.evidence: The reference floor has prominent tan wood grain and the range has a very dark front; the reconstructed floor is nearly uniform white with thin seams and the range is lighter teal.
main_defects.uncertainty: Lighting and exposure contribute to apparent material differences.

main_defects.description: The cooktop burner arrangement is simplified and the central clock display is missing from the control panel.
main_defects.evidence: Six circular burner marks and a central time display are visible in the reference; the reconstruction shows five burner marks and a blank panel between the knobs.
main_defects.uncertainty: The reconstruction is cropped on the left, so additional cooktop area may be outside the frame.

main_defects.description: The right-side cabinetry is represented by a regular grid of small drawers, unlike the reference's mixed large doors and differently sized drawer fronts. The countertop also lacks the reference's pronounced raised, folded-looking surface detail.
main_defects.evidence: The reference includes large white and dark front panels and irregularly sized colored sections, whereas the reconstruction shows a sequence of similarly sized square fronts.
main_defects.uncertainty: The different viewpoint and cropping affect which cabinet faces are visible.

main_defects.description: The reference has a strong bright diagonal patch across the floor and a dark doorway, while the reconstruction has comparatively diffuse, washed-out lighting and a lighter opening.
main_defects.evidence: The bright angular floor patch and deep dark gradient in the doorway are conspicuous in the reference but not reproduced in the reconstruction.
main_defects.uncertainty: The doorway darkness may also depend on the door and background materials, not lighting alone.

strengths: The narrow galley layout, left-hand range, right-hand countertop and upper cabinets, far doorway, and potted plant are recognizable.
The range retains two purple knobs, circular cooktop elements, a teal body, and a pink-purple handle.
The pale cabinetry with muted green and dark accents broadly echoes the reference palette. No claim is made about unseen geometry.
T1.uncertainty: This evaluation uses only the two supplied images. Camera framing, exposure, and occlusion can make geometry and material differences difficult to separate. Hidden surfaces and support relationships cannot be assessed reliably. The numerical score is an initial automated estimate.
